_readme: This file is the human gate. Adding an entry here is an assertion that you
personally confirmed the thing exists. Four repos have now shipped the same
class of published fiction past human review (tagit-website, tagit-website-v2,
tagit-sdk, tagit-services), and this repo is the fifth and worst: it documents
three SDKs, two of which have never existed in any form. The check exists
Every entry added on top of that baseline names how it was verified.
Keep entries few and keep them justified. A long allowlist means the check

_note: Any `<obj>.<namespace>.<method>(` call in any Markdown file must have its
`<obj>.<namespace>` prefix listed here, OR sit on a line that explicitly
says it does not exist (see denialPhrases). Default is DENY.
This is the check a link-checker cannot do. Every one of the ~40 fabricated
SDK methods found on the website on 2026-07-26 was a valid-looking identifier
pointing at nothing, and no link checker would ever have flagged them. The
same shapes are in this repo: tagit.assets.get, tagit.verify.submit,
tagit.nfc.readTag, tagit.transfers.initiate, tagit.programs.enroll.

source, not the docs: tagit-sdk/src/types/client.ts declares

at line 190. identity.register (client.ts:42) and identity.registrationFee

client.staking and client.events ADDED 2026-07-27, beyond the website-v2
baseline. The website only described those two in prose, so they needed no
entry there; this repo calls them, and without the entries the check reported
two genuinely-correct doc lines as fabrications. Verified before adding:
events   EventMethods declares watchAgentRegistered (client.ts:153) and
watchValidationFinalized (client.ts:170) — the exact two methods the

Scope caveat that belongs with this entry, because it is what the docs get
wrong: this client covers the ERC-8004 agent layer ONLY. It has no product
registration, verification, NFC, transfer or loyalty-program surface, and the
package is not published on npm. Its default chain is OP Sepolia 11155420,
which was deprecated 2026-06-27 in favour of Base Sepolia 84532.

_note: Every 0x-prefixed 40-hex-digit string in the repo must appear here EXACTLY,
including casing. This catches three failure modes at once: wrong EIP-55
casing, a stale/incorrect address, and tutorial filler.
Chosen over a computed EIP-55 checksum deliberately: the filler address
0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f5c9E8 that appeared 21 times on the
website was CORRECTLY checksummed. A checksum check would have passed it.
This repo currently contains 72 distinct addresses, most of them added in a
single bulk commit. They are deliberately NOT bulk-imported here: importing
them unverified is exactly the act this file exists to prevent. Each one has
to earn its entry.
Verify a new entry before adding it:
cast to-check-sum-address <addr>          # canonical casing
cast code <addr> --rpc-url https://sepolia.base.org   # non-empty = deployed
addresses._tagitCoreNote: 0x3aDc7EFDb58Ae85483eFf5D4966D916185f31d1D is TAGITCore on Base Sepolia 84532. Re-verified 2026-07-27 by eth_getCode against https://sepolia.base.org — returns non-empty bytecode (an ERC-1967 proxy). Unaudited.
addresses._placeholderNote: Documented placeholders that a reader is expected to substitute. Listed explicitly so they are a deliberate choice rather than an accident. Prefer the non-hex form 0xYOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS where the example does not need a valid-shaped address — a model cannot mistake that for a real one.
addresses._opSepoliaAgentNote: 0xA7f34FD…A78D / 0x57CCa197…6E4a / 0x98069191…86b7 are TAGITAgentIdentity, TAGITAgentReputation and TAGITAgentValidation on OP Sepolia 11155420 — the deployment DEPRECATED 2026-06-27 in favour of Base Sepolia 84532. Verified 2026-07-27: each returns non-empty bytecode from eth_getCode against https://sepolia.optimism.io (26640/15016/14446 hex chars), and each matches the checksum cast to-check-sum-address emits. They are listed in docs/sdk/sdk-api-reference.md ONLY under a heading marking the chain deprecated; do not present them as current.
addresses._bulkVerificationNote: ADDED 2026-07-27 (adversarial verification pass): the 62 remaining addresses in this repo. The prior note said they were deliberately NOT bulk-imported because importing unverified addresses is the act this file exists to prevent. They were therefore not imported — they were VERIFIED, one at a time, and the verification is reproducible. Method, run against both testnets for every address: (1) `cast to-check-sum-address <addr>` — all 62 already carried canonical EIP-55 casing, zero corrections needed; (2) `cast code <addr> --rpc-url https://sepolia.optimism.io` and `--rpc-url https://sepolia.base.org` — every address returned non-empty bytecode on at least one of the two chains, so none is a fabrication or a filler address; (3) for every documented proxy/implementation PAIR in docs/contracts/index.md, `eth_getStorageAt` on the ERC-1967 implementation slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc was compared against the documented implementation — all 20 pairs matched. Three findings came out of step (3) and were fixed in the docs, not papered over here: docs/contracts/tagit-core.md listed OP Sepolia TAGITCore implementation as 0x92c8e84a32D24b26B5Cf07d9a8CeD4DA8c055192 while the proxy 0x8BdE22da... actually points at 0x25F152bDD3c05B11eE1f3F94c450A0909EAf4B83 (different bytecode, 47623 vs 45343 hex chars); and docs/contracts/tagit-recovery.md and tagit-programs.md each listed a stale NON-proxy OP Sepolia deployment (0x6138a80c... and 0xe78DB770..., both with a zero ERC-1967 slot) that contradicted the index. Deployment does NOT imply audited, correct, or current — see _stalenessNote.
addresses._stalenessNote: An entry here means 'bytecode existed at this address on 2026-07-27', nothing more. It does not mean the contract is audited, is the current version, or is wired to anything useful. Two live examples inside this repo: 0xAdBAc728205c91F2FfF3194Bf0cAf13457e32b68 is a fully deployed TAGITCore whose totalSupply() is 0 and which is NOT the active core; and RoboticAuthorizer 0x38950034556e4DE9B9306b0d3d8563Bba7AcCeF0 has its coreContract() pointed at that empty core, so queryActionPolicy reverts AssetNotFound for every real asset. Both are documented as such in the pages that reference them. This checker cannot detect that class of problem — only a human reading the contract can.

_note: Substrings that must never appear as a positive assertion. A line is
exempt only if it also matches one of denialPhrases — that is how a page
is allowed to say 'this does not exist'.

BROADENED 2026-07-27 (verification pass) from '@tagit/sdk', which was itself broadened from the website's 'npm install @tagit/sdk'. The narrower string missed THREE further fabricated packages that were live in this repo: @tagit/react-native-sdk and @tagit/enterprise-sdk (docs/hardware/readers.md) and @tagit/cli (docs/index.md). All three return 404 from registry.npmjs.org, as does @tagit/sdk. The correct granularity is the whole SCOPE, not any one package: a registry search for @tagit returns 18 results of which the six @tagit/* entries (@tagit/ai-client-core, ai-client-react, presentation-web, presentation-core, presentation-playwright, presentation-react) are ALL published by an unrelated third party, maintainer tagit-admin <sandro@camarao.tv>. TAG IT Network owns nothing under this scope, so installing ANY @tagit/* package pulls a stranger's code. The JS/TS source does exist at tagit-sdk/, it is simply not published — say that instead.
No Python package exists in any form.

_denialNote: A line matching any of these is exempt from identifier/address/forbidden-string checks — that is how a page says 'this does not exist'. Keep every phrase narrow and unambiguous: a broad phrase (e.g. 'placeholder', 'cannot be', 'example') would silently exempt real violations and turn the check off without anyone noticing. --self-test is what catches that happening.

_note: Hosts skipped for external HTTP checking. Two reasons only:
(a) the host is a documented placeholder, or
(b) the host blocks automated requests, so a failure would be noise.
Matching covers subdomains: an entry for example.com also skips
agent.example.com. example.org and example.net ADDED 2026-07-27 alongside
that change — they are the other RFC 2606 reserved documentation domains and
can never resolve, so probing them can only ever produce noise.
This list is for placeholders and bot-walls ONLY. Never add a host here to
silence a real 404 — that is laundering a dead link into a green run.
urls._nonGetNote: Real, live endpoints that cannot be validated with a GET probe. api.tagit.network/verify is POST-only (GET correctly 404s) and appears in docs as the x402 'resource' field of a 402 response body, where no HTTP verb sits next to it for the parser to detect. This tool will never probe with POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE — sending a write request to production to satisfy a linter is not acceptable. Verified live 2026-07-26: POST returns the x402 402 payment envelope. sepolia.base.org ADDED 2026-07-27: it is the public Base Sepolia JSON-RPC endpoint, used as --rpc-url in the runnable cast/viem samples. It is POST-only, so a GET probe correctly returns 405. Verified live 2026-07-27: POST {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_chainId"} returns 0x14a34 = 84532 = Base Sepolia.

_skipPathsNote: Empty on purpose. The website port skipped docs/templates and docs/partials because they were build inputs carrying {{mustache}} placeholders; neither directory exists here, so carrying those entries across would have been dead config that quietly grew an exemption surface. tasks/ and wiki/ are NOT skipped: this repo renders nowhere, so every file in it is read as source on GitHub and is equally crawlable.

_note: Catches `someContract.method(` where the object name looks like one of ours.
The 3-segment identifier check misses these: `tagitCore.lifecycleState(tokenId)`
and `tagitCoreWithSigner.verify(tokenId, signals)` both shipped on the website
and neither function exists on TAGITCore. This repo has the same shape —
`tagitCore.bind(...)`, where the real function is bindTag.
Source of truth: grep 'function ' in tagit-contracts/src/. Also includes the
inherited ERC-721/ERC-20 surface and ethers/viem contract-object plumbing, so
ordinary integration code does not trip the check.
DO NOT add a method here to silence a violation. Confirm it in the Solidity
first — a fabricated entry here is worse than the fabricated doc it hides.

_codeScanNote: ADDED 2026-07-27 (adversarial verification pass). Markdown was never the whole published surface: examples/*/index.ts are runnable-looking source files, equally crawlable, and they carried the SAME fabrications as the prose (new TagIt({apiKey}), tagit.assets.create/get, tagit.transfers.initiate/accept, tagit.verify.createChallenge/submit) while the checker reported the repo green. Scanning only .md is how those files survived three agents. These directories get the forbidden-string / identifier / contract-call / address checks; Markdown-link resolution stays .md-only because source files carry no Markdown links, though bare URLs in comments are still probed.
